label: preparing
what: A possible coordinated bridge-or-port change associated with the bakery. Townsfolk repeatedly report a gathering there involving baker, freight, innkeeper, sometimes builder and neighbour, but the baker denied seeing any alteration and no firsthand confirmation was obtained. The planned evening meeting with the neighbour is described as ordinary and needs no preparation, so it is not evidence of a covert plan. No knowingly helping parties are confirmed from the mayor's firsthand evidence; the gathered names are only reported as present, not proven to know or help with a plan.
